source: ShopCart: in-house demo e-commerce app. Each bug is a seeded mutation of the fixed app (app/). Bug shop_discount is the 'Discount is incorrectly applied to orders below Rs 1,000' use case from the course slides.

bugs.title: Discount is incorrectly applied to orders below Rs 1,000
bugs.body:
The e-commerce application provides a 10% discount for orders of Rs 1,000 or more. However, customers have reported that the discount is also being applied to orders below Rs 1,000.
Steps to reproduce: 1. Add products worth Rs 800 to the cart. 2. Proceed to checkout. 3. Observe the bill.
Expected: orders below Rs 1,000 should not receive a discount; the discount should be 0 and the amount before tax should remain Rs 800.
Actual: the application applies a 10% discount (Rs 80) and the discounted amount is Rs 720.
The issue occurs consistently. The repository contains existing unit tests for checkout functionality.

bugs.title: Shipping charged on orders of exactly Rs 500
bugs.body: Our policy says orders of Rs 500 or more ship for free. A customer whose order came to exactly Rs 500 was still charged the Rs 50 shipping fee at checkout. Expected shipping for a Rs 500 order: 0.

bugs.title: Coupon code rejected when typed in lowercase
bugs.body: Entering the coupon 'save10' in the cart is rejected (Cart.apply_coupon returns False), while 'SAVE10' works. Coupon codes are supposed to be case-insensitive, so 'save10' should be accepted.

bugs.title: GST is off by one paisa
bugs.body: The GST shown on some bills is one paisa too low. For a taxable amount of Rs 12.25 the 18% GST is 2.205, which should round to Rs 2.21, but the app shows Rs 2.20 (shopcart.pricing.gst).

bugs.old:
if not cart.items:
        raise ValueError("cart is empty")
bugs.title: Checkout of an empty cart crashes with an obscure error
bugs.body: If a user clicks checkout with an empty cart the server crashes with a decimal InvalidOperation / division error. Checkout of an empty cart should be rejected with a clear ValueError saying the cart is empty.

bugs.title: Setting quantity to 0 does not remove the item
bugs.body: In the cart page, setting an item's quantity to 0 should remove it from the cart (Cart.set_quantity). Instead the item stays in the cart with quantity 0 and still shows up in the order.

bugs.old: return self.items.pop(sku, None) is not None
bugs.title: Removing an item twice crashes
bugs.body: Double-clicking the remove button sends two remove requests. The second one crashes with a KeyError. Cart.remove is documented to return False when the item is not in the cart.

bugs.title: Inventory not reduced correctly after checkout
bugs.body: A product had 10 units in stock. A customer bought 3 units of it in one order, but after checkout the product's stock shows 9 instead of 7.

bugs.title: Something is wrong
bugs.body: The website doesn't work properly sometimes. Please look into it.
